label: Totality esse-cause route controls
paraphrase: Exact interpretations only, on q3a4 profiles with all bearers actual. (1) Joint model: premises A and B, no self-causation of esse, distinct-esse coverage, identity uniqueness and a received bearer hold with the common uncaused cause, CCR and an infinite descending chain (no well-foundedness). (2) Hume-Edwards regress: A fails while B, no self-causation, coverage, uniqueness, every bearer received and freedom from causal loops hold; CCR fails. (3) Two-bearer loop with internal totality causes: B fails; CCR fails. (4) An actual uncaused totality cause that supplies no member: B fails; CCR fails. (5) A self-causing totality cause: no self-causation fails; A and B hold; CCR fails. (6) An ascending rooted chain: CCR and the finite-path common source hold without a common uncaused cause on the given edges. (7) Two independent identity roots with a transitively closed relation: CCR and coverage hold, identity uniqueness and the common uncaused cause fail. Logical controls, not metaphysical counterexamples.
